narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran as one. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. By month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the fallback each of you could reach no longer matching. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, and that month the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost held {net_worth_gap}. How long each of you could last with no pay finished {safety_gap}.
